additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Luca,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset

MP / P7 170000808
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
P8Fdi7
Problem Description
: Firmware Downgrade.
Troubleshooting
:
Please confirm if there are two issues that require attention:
1. Firmware Downgrade to version 4.0.11.
Regarding this problem, I'll discuss with the Experts to downgrade this charger with the help of SSH.
2. HMI visibility issue.
Regarding this problem:
- Ensure there are no loose connections between the screen and board.
- Update the Dlogic firmware.
- Verify the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board.
- Check if the DP cables have been previously replaced with this charger, if not, it is recommended to replace them with new DP cables.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0377278
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma

additional_info.body:
Hello  Luca,
I have assigned the on-site activities to your queue for further planning. Feel free to contact me if you require any assistance. If my working hours do not align with the task, a member of the NOC team will provide support. In addition, for the OCPP disconnections, please ensure you have an extra router, SIM cards, and a couple of Ethernet cables. It is advisable to carry a spare HMI if the site is too far away from the home, in case the HMI is damaged internally. This will allow for a quick replacement, ensuring operational continuity. If the HMI is not replaced, it can be utilized in future projects during upcoming site interventions.
